_comment: Owner-defined billing rules. The engine applies these in a fixed order; the AI never does the arithmetic. Bump `version` whenever you change anything so every quote/invoice records which rules produced it.

negotiation._comment: How the assistant bargains with NEW buyers. Each counter-offer still needs the owner's approval. Steps are % off the quoted bill; it never goes beyond maxDiscountPct (per-product maxDiscountPct can be lower).
